title: feat(rest): the recycle bin has REST doors, and a delete answer names the entry to undo (#30237 PR 5)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X9p73F432cc8kwWQBkFm1pQ)_

Part of #30237

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up #30847

Spec consent: 6721939207 (S1 `DeleteDataResponseSchema.recycleBinEntryId`, optional; S3 `api-derivation.ts` derives `restore` / `purge` from `delete`, docblock corrected). S2 (the `EngineDeleteOptions` out-channel) is NOT committed in spec: the callback is typed in objectql instead, see Acceptance notes. Claim amendment 6721792971. PR 5 of 5 (hand-over 6690307585): the recycle bin's REST doors. Also answers #30239 (the delete answer names the entry to undo).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：回收站有了 REST 入口，一次一个对象：`GET /data/:object/recycle-bin` 列出条目（仅 `manageRecycleBin` 持有者，行值按调用者在该对象上的字段级权限裁剪，掩码字段不返回），`POST …/:entryId/restore` 恢复一条，`DELETE …/:entryId` 清除一条，`DELETE …/recycle-bin` 清空该对象的回收站。`DELETE /data/:object/:id` 的应答在写入回收站条目时带上 `recycleBinEntryId`，客户端可据此提供"撤销"。引擎新增 `listRecycleBin`，`restore` / `purge` 可限定条目所属对象；客户端新增 `client.recycleBin.list / restore / purge / empty`。
- 为什么改：PR 1–4 已上线回收站及其权限，但只有引擎调用可达，用户和客户端无从列出、恢复或清除；#30239 要求删除应答指明可撤销的条目。
- 风险与回滚：放宽（Clause-② widening）：新增四个 REST 入口和一个可选应答键。`Metadata-protocol: semantic`：对象的 API 派生集合在暴露 `delete` 时现在包含 `restore` / `purge`（此前恒为关闭），撤去 `delete` 的对象四个入口一律 405。列表在无权限解析器时拒绝（fail closed）。回滚即 revert，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/rest/src/recycle-bin-routes.ts`（四个入口、字段裁剪 `servedFieldsOf`、恢复回执 `restoreReceipt`、错误应答 `answerThrown`）；`packages/objectql/src/recycle-bin/list.ts`（`listRecycleBin` 与 `assertCallerManagesRecycleBin`）；`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`（按 id 删除后的 `onRecycleBinEntry`）；`packages/spec/src/data/api-derivation.ts`（S3）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/recycle-bin-routes.test.ts` 与 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/recycle-bin/list.test.ts`，预期全部通过，含「answers 405 at every door of an object whose API withholds `delete`」「with only a read projection, withholds every field that declares a maskingRule」「refuses, 403, when no permission resolver answers」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（契约复核由席位执行）。

## What changes

**The doors (`packages/rest/src/recycle-bin-routes.ts`, new; seat ruling S4).** Four routes under `{data}/:object/recycle-bin`, registered inside `api.enableCrud` before CRUD's `/:object/:id` (first match wins, the export precedent):

| Door | Exposure gate | Engine call | Answer |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET {data}/:object/recycle-bin` | `restore` | `listRecycleBin(object, { context, limit, offset })` | `{ object, entries, hasMore }`; each row's values cut to the caller's fields |
| `POST {data}/:object/recycle-bin/:entryId/restore` | `restore` | `restore(entryId, { context, object })` | the restore receipt; `null` → `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`; a stale roll-up → `200` with what was written |
| `DELETE {data}/:object/recycle-bin/:entryId` | `purge` | `purge(entryId, { context, object })` | `{ object, entryId, purged: true }`; `false` → `404` |
| `DELETE {data}/:object/recycle-bin` | `purge` | `empty(object, { context })` | `{ object, removed }` |

- **Closed query sets.** The list takes `limit` / `offset` only; the acts take none. Unknown or repeated parameters → `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`. `limit` / `offset` are read through `readDeclaredQueryNumber` against declared bounds (`limit` 1–200, `offset` ≥ 0). A refused value → `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, with `details.fields` naming the parameter (#20139).
- **FLS on the list.** Values come from `getQueryableFields` on the row's live object: readable minus masked. If the service has only `getReadableFields`, every field that declares a `maskingRule` is dropped, whoever asks. If there is no answer, a row keeps its `id` alone. If there is no security service, values are served as stored. The snapshot and its cleared references are never served.
- **Restore receipt.** The restore answer is read field by field from the engine report: `entryId`, `object`, `recordId`, `rows` as `{ object, id }`, and `relinked`. No record body is served (#8497).
- **Refusals.** A classified refusal is answered at its own status and code, in the nested envelope. Its `details` carry `entryId`, `object`, `recordId`, `field`, `parentObject`, `parentId`, `parentEntryId` and `param`, so a client can restore a parent entry first. An unreadable authorization input answers `503`. A sandbox fault answers as the data doors do. Anything else is a `500` with its text withheld.

**The engine (objectql).**
- `listRecycleBin(object, { context, limit, offset })` is a host-literal delegation.
- It refuses a platform object `400`, and a bad `limit` / `offset` `400` naming the parameter.
- `assertCallerManagesRecycleBin` refuses `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` unless the effective permissions grant `manageRecycleBin` on the object. It fails closed when no resolver answers or the resolver throws. The system is exempt.
- An object with no bin, or a caller the wall denies, gets an empty page.
- The read is newest first (`deleted_at desc, id desc`), with `limit + 1` rows fetched to answer `hasMore`.
- `restore` / `purge` take an optional `object`. An entry of another object answers `null` / `false` and nothing is dispatched.
- `callerRecycleBinManagement` was factored out of the restore check, which keeps its text.
- `recycleBinPlatformObjectRefusal` is exported from `purge.ts`.

**The delete answer names the entry (#30239; seat ruling S2).**
- The by-id `delete` tells `options.onRecycleBinEntry(entryId)` the entry it wrote. It does so after the transaction commits, and only when the driver reports the row removed (not `false` or `0`).
- The callback is declared on objectql's exported `RecycleBinDeleteObservability`, and `ObjectQL.delete` takes `EngineDeleteOptions & RecycleBinDeleteObservability`. This is the `WriteObservabilityOptions` shape update already uses.
- `ENGINE_DELETE_OPTION_KEYS` admits the key, and the drift pin lists it as delete's one type-only extra.
- metadata-protocol `deleteData` answers `recycleBinEntryId` when it is told one.
- `@objectstack/client` `DeleteDataResult` gains the key.

**Spec (consent 6721939207; S1 and S3).**
- S1: `DeleteDataResponseSchema.recycleBinEntryId: z.string().optional()`.
- S3: `restore: { all: ['delete'] }`, `purge: { all: ['delete'] }`. The docblock and the `isApiOperationAllowed` comment are corrected, and `api-derivation.test.ts` is updated.
- `authorable-surface/api.json` was regenerated by the build (one row).

**Client.** `client.recycleBin.list(object, { limit, offset })`, `.restore(object, entryId)`, `.purge(object, entryId)` and `.empty(object)`. The `RecycleBinPage` and `RecycleBinRestoreReport` types are added.

**Route ledger, OpenAPI, discovery.**
- Four `recycle-bin` rows (disposition `sdk`, clients `recycleBin.*`).
- The doors register on the route manager with summary and tags, so they appear in `/openapi.json` through `getRoutes()`.
- Discovery is unchanged: the doors sit under `routes.data` (S4, no `ApiRoutesSchema` change).

**Docs.**
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/http-protocol.mdx`: the "no recycle-bin runtime" warning is replaced. It gains a "Recycle Bin" section with the doors table, and the delete answer example now shows `recycleBinEntryId`.
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`: row 29f owns the list check's `isSystem` read. The register was regenerated with `--write`.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/recycle-bin-routes.test.ts` (new, 33):
  - Every door's happy path and engine arguments.
  - FLS through `getQueryableFields`; the read-projection fallback withholds `maskingRule` fields; no answer leaves only the `id`.
  - The snapshot is never served.
  - Closed and declared query parameters.
  - The engine's 403, the 409 refusal `details`, and 404s.
  - A stale roll-up → 200.
  - The restore receipt drops anything the report carries beyond its five members.
  - An anonymous caller is refused before anything is listed; 501 when the engine has no bin; an unexpected fault is a 500 without its message.
  - The exposure describe: an object whose API withholds `delete` → 405 at all four doors, and no engine verb is called.
- `packages/objectql/src/recycle-bin/list.test.ts` (new, 26):
  - Ordering and paging.
  - `manageRecycleBin` / `modifyAllRecords` allowed.
  - No resolver, `allowRestoreOwnDeleted` only, `allowDelete` only, manage without read, manage on another object, and a throwing resolver are each refused 403 with no read.
  - System, wall deny, no bin, platform 400, bad paging.
  - `restore` / `purge` under another object.
  - `onRecycleBinEntry`: told after removal; not told for permanent, no bin, a platform object, or a driver answering `false` / `0`; not told when the removal throws, and the entry goes with it.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.delete-recycle-bin-entry.test.ts` (new): the answer carries `recycleBinEntryId` and parses against `DeleteDataResponseSchema`; no key when no entry was written.
- Census and pins updated for the new module:
  - `objectql-slot-consumer-census` (8)
  - `REST_SERVER_REGISTRAR_FILES`
  - the hook-refusal sentence ledger (three write rows, driven)
  - the canonical-query-ast floors (0, sum unchanged)
  - the docblock-position floors (11, sum 119)
  - the mount table (`api.enableCrud` removes the four doors)
  - the #8497 write-response tripwire (three `no-record-echo` rows)
  - `check:route-envelope` (`{ responses: 0, ok: 0, err: 0 }`)
  - the client limit-emitter family (`recycleBin.list`)
  - `engine-unknown-option` drift pin

<details><summary>Ablations (9, each red, each restored to HEAD by scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

A1–A4b run objectql `src/recycle-bin/list.test.ts`, A5–A9 run rest `src/recycle-bin-routes.test.ts`.

- `A1-list-manager` (the manager refusal never throws): 6 failed | 18 passed; e.g. "refuses, 403, when no permission resolver answers: it fails closed, and reads nothing"
- `A2-restore-object` (object mismatch line deleted): 1 failed | 23 passed; "restore answers null, and dispatches nothing, for an entry of another object"
- `A3-purge-object` (object mismatch line deleted): 1 failed | 23 passed; "purge answers false, and dispatches nothing, for an entry of another object"
- `A4b-callback-on-unremoved` (entry told whatever the driver answered): 2 failed | 24 passed; "does not call back when the driver answers false (not found)", "… 0 (kept)"
- `A5-rest-exposure` (the purge door's exposure gate removed): 1 failed | 32 passed; "answers 405 at every door of an object whose API withholds `delete`, and calls no engine verb"
- `A6-fls-fields` (every value served): 3 failed | 30 passed; e.g. "lists the object's entries as the caller, with each row's values cut to the fields it may query on"
- `A7-mask-fallback` (fallback keeps masked fields): 1 failed | 32 passed; "with only a read projection, withholds every field that declares a maskingRule"
- `A8-restore-receipt` (engine report served verbatim): 1 failed | 32 passed; "answers a receipt, never a record body: a member the report carries beyond its five is not served (#8497)"
- `A9-paging-declared` (`limit` declared as any number): 3 failed | 30 passed; e.g. "refuses {"limit":"1.5"} through its declaration (limit), 400 naming the parameter"

A first A4 leg (entry id taken before `driver.delete`) stayed green. A throwing removal skips the callback by exception propagation alone, so that pin cannot see the placement. The "driver answers `false` / `0`" pin (A4b) was added for the case that the placement does decide.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Deviations from the claim surface (6721792971)**, each needed by the delete answer or by a gate:
  - `packages/metadata-protocol` (`deleteData` answers the key)
  - `packages/client` (`recycleBin.*`, the `DeleteDataResult` pin)
  - the spec test `api-derivation.test.ts`
  - the regenerated `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` (one row, from S1)
  - the generated `authorable-surface/api.json`
  - `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` (the new module's declaration)
- **`Metadata-protocol: semantic`, and `@objectstack/spec` is `minor`.** The authorable-surface shard moved, so `none` is refused by `check-changeset-no-major`, and the derived restore/purge exposure changes meaning. The other four packages are `patch`.
- **A row the driver does not remove keeps its bin entry.** A by-id delete whose driver answers `false` / `0` still leaves the entry written before it. The answer no longer names it. Compensating it there would also drop any cascaded children captured in the same entry, so it is left as it was before this PR (PR 1 behaviour) and is not changed here.
- **S2 was taken out of spec.** Putting the callback on `EngineDeleteOptions` had two effects:
  - It turned the bare alias into an intersection, so `check:spec-parsed-alias` (ADR-0122) asked for a line to be deleted from `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts`.
  - `HookDeleteOptions = Omit<EngineDeleteOptions, …>` (`hook-api.ts`) would have given app hook bodies the callback.

  Both files are outside consent 6721939207. The callback is therefore typed in objectql, beside the options, the way update's `WriteObservabilityOptions` are. `data-engine.zod.ts` is byte-identical to main. The spec diff is now S1 + S3 only, which is narrower than the consent.
- **The list rides the `restore` exposure gate** (there is no `list` verb on the bin). Purge and empty ride `purge`.

## Verification

Head `274a8241fc` (origin/main `6ed533f6b6` merged). 32 files changed, +1804 / −49.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 140 families, each run with its exit captured before any pipe. Every one exits 0 on the final tree. `--ran` reconciliation: `140 derived, 140 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.

  - `check:docs` (the protocol reference regenerated)
  - `check:spec-parsed-alias` (answered by taking S2 out of spec)
  - `check:test-source-alias` (module-top side-effect imports in six touched tests)
- `spec check:generated`: exit 0. `check:system-context-census` (row 29f + `--write`) and `check:route-envelope`: exit 0.
- `tsc --noEmit` for spec, objectql, metadata-protocol, client and rest: exit 0. eslint (`--no-inline-config`) over the 27 touched source files: exit 0.
